events.title: Global Trade Expansion
events.description: International shipping demand surges across major sea lanes, increasing global commercial revenues and providing a stimulus to export nations.

events.title: Global Energy Disruption
events.description: Volatility in international petroleum markets triggers price spikes, testing national reserve stability and industrial power supply.

events.title: Geneva World Peace Accord
events.description: Delegates at the United Nations pass a consensus resolution affirming sovereign non-aggression, fostering international goodwill and diplomatic thaw.

events.title: Cross-Border Military Drills
events.description: Heightened maneuvers along contested strategic frontiers cause neighboring armed forces to elevate readiness alerts.

events.title: WHO Respiratory Virus Alert
events.description: An infectious respiratory cluster reported abroad triggers health monitoring protocols across all entry ports and international airports.

events.title: Breakthrough in Clean Fusion Energy
events.description: An international consortium announces experimental net-positive fusion energy milestones, uplifting public confidence and scientific optimism.
